# Review desk Specification

<!-- Generated by scripts/openspec.js from specs/ (Spec Kit is the source of truth for these requirements). Edit specs/NNN-*/spec.md or openspec/capabilities.json, then run: node scripts/openspec.js sync -->

## Purpose

Judging papers, articles and comments with explainable, guarded judges: canonical text, evidence markers, kinds, verdict bands, source grades, two-model panels, peer reviews, comment roles and topic dossiers.

## Requirements

### Requirement: REQ-027 Submit a paper
A signed-in reader SHOULD be able to submit a paper, article or comment and get an explained judgement (significance, rigor, hype) that resists the gaming listed in User Story 1, catalogued in the knowledge graph and open to a person's agree or disagree label.

Source: `specs/002-research-layer/spec.md`, proposed, not approved: needs both partners. Code: `modules/review` (`review.js`, `store.js`), `/m/review`; `superintelligence` profile on every review and in the published criteria (`/research/criteria`).

#### Scenario: REQ-027 is checked
- **WHEN** the checks named in docs/SPEC_TRACE.md run (unit: review (24 checks); review demo; bench `review.*`)
- **THEN** they pass, as preflight and the browser test require

### Requirement: REQ-031 Produce an evidence dossier
For any topic, the system SHOULD produce an evidence dossier (reviewed papers and articles, our own toy checks, feed coverage, reader comments counted, and organisations and watched people as mention counts only) with a stated rating rule that never rates beyond what abstracts and toy checks support, and turn it into a blog draft, short posts and an explainer video in which every statement cites a numbered reference traced to its record; a person publishes them.

Source: `specs/002-research-layer/spec.md`, proposed, not approved: needs both partners. Code: `modules/review/dossier.js`, `/m/dossier`, `/api/review/dossier/:topic`, evidence index `/m/evidence` and `/api/review/evidence-index`, worker job `dossier`, `/m/explainer?d=<topic>`.

#### Scenario: REQ-031 is checked
- **WHEN** the checks named in docs/SPEC_TRACE.md run (unit: dossier and pipeline-quality; `test/story-page-unit.js` checks canonical scores, source IDs and admission; review demo: "Dossier")
- **THEN** they pass, as preflight and the browser test require

### Requirement: REQ-032 (spec 002) Run as its own site
The research layer MAY run as its own site (for example a research subdomain) that publishes plain-language write-ups of reviewed papers and topic dossiers, tagged as a preview and not indexed, and an RSS feed of them that the spec version can add as one more source; it stays hidden unless that deployment opts in, leaves out doubtful reviews and comments, and keeps each paper's own title so the write-up joins the paper's existing story.

Source: `specs/002-research-layer/spec.md`, proposed, not approved: needs both partners. Code: `modules/research/`, `SITE_PROFILE=research`, `/research`, `/research/feed.xml`, `RESEARCH_PUBLIC`.

#### Scenario: REQ-032 is checked
- **WHEN** the checks named in docs/SPEC_TRACE.md run (test: research feed (24 checks, in preflight))
- **THEN** they pass, as preflight and the browser test require

### Requirement: REQ-033 (spec 002) Grade where each reviewed piece comes from
The system SHOULD grade where each reviewed piece comes from (A to E by a published rule: the outlet's kind, whether it cites primary research, hype, and selling its own product), record each dated forecast in a piece as an event that a person later marks as happened or not, keep track records by outlet (personal blogs and newsletters pooled as a class, never tracked by the writer; Brier scores for forecasts that state a probability), and show how loudly a topic is talked about next to how strong its evidence is without letting the talk change the evidence rating. Forecasts are never attributed to a named person. The criteria are published as the same table the judge uses.

Source: `specs/002-research-layer/spec.md`, proposed, not approved: needs both partners. Code: `modules/review/sources.js`, `CRITERIA` in `modules/review/review.js`, `review_events`, `/api/review/outlets`, `/api/review/events`, `/research/criteria`, `/research/outlets`.

#### Scenario: REQ-033 is checked
- **WHEN** the checks named in docs/SPEC_TRACE.md run (unit: sources (31 checks), pipeline-quality (valid buzz windows/hype), review (criteria checks); bench item `b-hype-press-words`)
- **THEN** they pass, as preflight and the browser test require

### Requirement: REQ-034 (spec 002) Be made by at least two different models
Every judgement made in the background SHOULD be made by at least two different models (from different makers, through free or local providers) as well as the rules judge, each reading the text with authors, outlet, links and names masked, tested for prestige sensitivity (fake top-journal versus anonymous-blog labels) and wording sensitivity (hype words neutralised), with rubric order varied and every met check backed by a quote found in the text. Models over the sensitivity limits are set aside; agreeing models are averaged with the rules judge; disagreeing models give the most conservative result and send the piece to a person; with fewer than two usable models the rules judge's result stands, marked incomplete. A bigger model MAY advise when the models disagree or sit far from the rules judge, and MAY review the judging quality to propose synthetic benchmark items, but it never sets a score and its proposals are adopted only by a person. The web server never calls a model.

Source: `specs/002-research-layer/spec.md`, proposed, not approved: needs both partners. Code: `modules/review/panel.js`, `scripts/watch.js`, `PANEL_MODELS`, `CRITERIA.panel`.

#### Scenario: REQ-034 is checked
- **WHEN** the checks named in docs/SPEC_TRACE.md run (unit: panel (22 checks, stand-in models, including the advisor); `scripts/advise.js`)
- **THEN** they pass, as preflight and the browser test require

### Requirement: REQ-032 (spec 003) Put the text in a canonical form
Before judging, the system SHOULD put the text in a canonical form (Unicode NFKC, zero-width and format characters removed, confusable letters mapped for the guards, whitespace collapsed, common LaTeX forms rewritten), derive the document id from the canonical text and, for arXiv papers, the id and version, and report any truncation as a reason.

### Requirement: REQ-033 (spec 003) Compute every score from the canonical abstract
For a paper with a source abstract, the system SHOULD compute every score from the canonical abstract and check any paraphrase separately for fidelity (numbers and units, named entities, hedges, negation, claims added or dropped), withholding a paraphrase that fails and never letting it change a score; the abstract itself is used at judging time and only a hash and the 400-character excerpt are stored (REQ-007).

### Requirement: REQ-034 (spec 003) Recognise the equivalent wordings
The evidence markers SHOULD recognise the equivalent wordings and number forms in the edge-case catalogue, and the catalogue SHOULD gate changes: a case marked `ok` that breaks fails preflight, and the count of known gaps is reported and only goes down (REQ-029).

### Requirement: REQ-035 Earn nothing
Negated markers, hype words inside negations or names, and text that describes attacks rather than addressing the judge SHOULD earn nothing and trigger nothing; text that addresses the judge in other words or with hidden characters SHOULD still be flagged.

### Requirement: REQ-036 Recognise surveys
The kind detector SHOULD recognise surveys and reviews by their common title forms, and distinguish position papers, datasets or benchmarks and negative results, each judged on what that kind of paper can show.

### Requirement: REQ-037 Use half-open bands around each cutoff with a stated
Verdicts and the dossier's "credible" test SHOULD use half-open bands around each cutoff with a stated margin m such that 2m is at least the largest change one marker can make to that score (so a single marker can never skip the Border band), show Border items as borderline, count only High items as credible, and change a stored band only with a new paper version or rules version.

### Requirement: REQ-038 Be checked by property tests on every change
The scoring rules' properties (bounds, the caps, no double counting, monotonicity, idempotent canonicalisation, exhaustive bands, the one-step band limit) SHOULD be checked by property tests on every change, and the arithmetic layer SHOULD be written as portable rules with a Lean 4 model that proves them and a differential test against the JavaScript evaluator; Lean runs in the worker, not on the web server.

### Requirement: REQ-039 Show their aspect tags
Where public peer reviews exist, the system SHOULD show their aspect tags, mean, spread and count with their licence and link, never reviewer identities, and treat a paper without reviews as unreviewed.

### Requirement: REQ-040 Be marked by role
Reader comments SHOULD be marked by role (claim, question, evidence, rebuttal) and stance (leans agree, leans disagree, unclear) with the deciding cue words, give length credit only up to a cap, credit only checkable evidence (links, arXiv ids, DOIs), and use bridging-style ranking only with at least 5 ratings per comment and 10 per rater.

Source: `specs/003-judge-fidelity/spec.md`, proposed, not approved: needs both partners. Code: not built yet.
